tension: Indian consumers are seeking modern skincare solutions that incorporate traditional heritage ingredients, driving demand for products that combine ancient wisdom with contemporary formulation science. This tension is fueled by the growing interest in fermented skincare and bio-fermented actives, which are perceived as effective and natural.
why_now: The recent surge in acquisitions and investments in the beauty sector, coupled with the rise of D2C brands and the increasing popularity of fermented skincare, makes this an opportune time for Neude to capitalize on its unique positioning. The brand can leverage its Indian milk-based beauty rituals and contemporary formulation science to cater to the evolving consumer needs.
